# WorkbenchInspector

<a name="WorkbenchInspector"></a>

## WorkbenchInspector(props) ⇒

Compose labeled navigation above a resizable inspector and independent preview.
Pointer gestures never write client configuration or invoke lifecycle animation.

**Kind**: global function
**Returns**: A keyboard-accessible split workbench with a mobile drawer fallback.

| Param | Description                                               |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| props | Grouped controls and the persistent live preview subtree. |

<a name="WorkbenchInspector..commit"></a>

### WorkbenchInspector~commit

Persist successful user layout choices independently of the client theme.

**Kind**: inner constant of [<code>WorkbenchInspector</code>](#WorkbenchInspector)
